description: This Java class handles the command to delete a savings product in the FinTech application, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and invoking the SavingsProductWritePlatformService to perform the deletion based on the command's entity ID.

classes.name: DeleteSavingsProductCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles delete commands for savings products, utilizing the SavingsProductWritePlatformService to perform deletions based on command input.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the service layer to delete the savings product based on the entity ID from the command.
